description: The plot illustrates the "Massive Activation of baseline" by comparing four different metrics across various layers. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 23, featuring tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled "Max Activation Value" with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1600, featuring tick marks at intervals of 200. The blue dashed line, representing "attn_output", starts at a value of approximately 0 at layer 0, remains steady near 0 across most of the x-axis, and rises to approximately 250 at layer 23. The orange dotted line, representing "attn_residual", begins at approximately 0 at layer 0, remains flat until layer 4, then rises sharply to approximately 1400 at layer 6. It continues to rise slightly to about 1480 at layer 8, remains steady until layer 12, and rises again to approximately 1580 at layer 14. It maintains this peak level until layer 21, before declining to approximately 1550 at layer 22 and dropping sharply to 250 at layer 23. The green dash-dot line, representing "ffn_output", starts at approximately 0 at layer 0, remains flat until layer 4, and exhibits three distinct sharp peaks: it spikes to approximately 1400 at layer 5 before dropping to near 40 at layer 6, spikes again to approximately 1000 at layer 13 before dropping to near 100 at layer 14, and spikes a third time to approximately 1200 at layer 22 before ending at approximately 550 at layer 23. Between these peaks, the values remain low, near 0 to 50. The red solid line, representing "ffn_residual", starts at approximately 0 at layer 0, remains flat until layer 4, and rises sharply to approximately 1400 at layer 5. It increases slightly to about 1480 at layer 7, remains steady until layer 12, and rises to approximately 1580 at layer 13. It maintains this high value until layer 20, drops slightly to 1550 at layer 21, experiences a sharp decline to approximately 400 at layer 22, and ends with a rise to approximately 600 at layer 23.
